original_card.question: Does one explicit extension of the connector alphabet offer a favorable completed budget?
methods: Construct and charge a legal extra operation on a minimal instance.
Prove a target-specific bound after adding one specified operation family.
original_card.acceptance_gate: State which fixed-alphabet premise changes and charge its implementation; do not declare it free. A scoped local result may be retained without a complete supplier. Expanding it into further construction rounds requires the family-level budget and obligation gate in research-family-status.md; an optimistic passing relaxation alone is not acceptance.

first_step.inspect: Reproduce the 945-pairing control, then read Exact interface to list the allowed calls.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Add exactly one legally priced operation and test a tiny dirty-input instance before enumerating larger cases.
original_card.bottleneck_link: A new legal connector operation could change recursive interface cost; a larger census in the same alphabet is a separate side result.
allowed_variations: Choose one additional operation and a small source count for its first counterexample.
scope_change_triggers: Keeping the alphabet and only increasing the source count; record this as a changed assignment.
Extending a source-count census without naming a supplier/interface decision it could change; audit #2973 pruning concerns before relying on the affected predecessor exclusions.

actual_scope: In the fixed additive alphabet {B: z += x, A: y += z}, what is the exact minimum complete-call length of the one-source one-output identity over F3 with arbitrary dirty x, y and z?
scope_change_reason: The starting README already states that ordinary addition in odd characteristic does not inherit the F2 construction. Live alphabet-extension PRs already cover arity-four source events, joint outputs, high-arity toggles and the direct product call. This package keeps the same two operators and changes only the characteristic-two premise those extensions still rely on for dirt cancellation.
bottleneck_link: Paired A readouts cancel connector dirt only because 1+1=0. In F3 that cancellation fails, so the inherited four-call 1x1 witness is not available and the recursive interface bill rises before any larger census.
stop_rule: Stop at the exact 1x1 F3 minimum. Do not extend to five sources, signed patterns or a new operator family.
evidence: Over F3 every correct word needs a multiple of three B calls and a multiple of three A calls, so length at least 6. An exhaustive search finds no correct word of length at most 5 and exactly six words of length 6, all with three B and three A: BBAABA, BABBAA, BAABAB, ABBAAB, ABABBA, AABABB. The F2 control BABA remains length 4.
author: Riquelme Soares (@hevlyo)
ai_assistance: Substantial AI assistance was used for the exhaustive search, the modular lower bound, the verifier and the write-up. No independent human review is claimed.

open_questions.question: For the five-source all-31-mask batch over F3 with the same additive alphabet, what is the exact optimum?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The F2 optimum is 74. The 1x1 lift from 4 to 6 already shows a 50% local increase; the batch ratio is unknown.
open_questions.first_step: Search restored words with each of five B labels used a multiple of three times and each of 31 A labels used a multiple of three times, starting from a short positive witness.
open_questions.blocked_by: The search space is much larger than the 945 F2 pairings, and no F3 five-source witness is pinned here.
